stem.text: A diffraction grating with $N$ lines per metre is used to diffract light of various wavelengths $\lambda$.
The graph shows the relation between the diffraction angle $\theta$ and $\lambda$ for different wavelengths in the $n^{\text{th}}$ order interference pattern.

stem.alt: Graph of sin θ against λ, a straight line from the origin. Axes labelled sin θ (vertical) and λ (horizontal), with 0 marked at the origin.
